question: The first ever South Asian Games held in India took place in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1987**__.

**__Key Points__**
__

• The **South Asian Games**, originally known as the **South Asian Federation Games (SAF Games)**, is a biennial multi-sport event held among athletes from the **South Asian** region.

• The **first ever South Asian Games** to be hosted in **India** took place in **1987**. This was the **3rd edition** of the games. ***Hence, the correct answer is 1987.***

• The **1987 South Asian Federation Games** were held in **Calcutta** (now **Kolkata**), West Bengal. This event marked the first time the country hosted this specific regional competition.

• The inaugural edition of the South Asian Games was held in **Kathmandu, Nepal**, in **1984**, and the second edition was held in **Dhaka, Bangladesh**, in **1985**.

• Option **1982** is incorrect because, in that year, **India** hosted the **9th Asian Games** in **New Delhi**, which is a different multi-sport event involving all of **Asia**.

• Options **1991** and **1995** are incorrect as the first instance of hosting occurred earlier in **1987**, although **India** did host the games again in **1995** in **Madras** (now **Chennai**).

**Additional Information__**
__

• The governing body for the games is the **South Asian Sports Council (SASC)**, which was formed in **1983** to promote sports and brotherhood among **South Asian** nations.

• There are currently **eight participating nations** in the South Asian Games: **Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka**.

• **India** has hosted the South Asian Games on **three occasions**: the **3rd edition** in **1987** (**Calcutta**), the **7th edition** in **1995** (**Madras**), and the **12th edition** in **2016** (**Guwahati** and **Shillong**).

• In the **1987 Games** held in **India**, athletes competed in **10 different sports**, including **Athletics, Basketball, Boxing, Football, Kabaddi, Swimming, Table Tennis, Volleyball, Weightlifting, and Wrestling**.

• **India** has maintained a dominant record in the competition, finishing at the **top of the medal tally** in every single edition of the South Asian Games since **1984**.

**Important Points__**

• The **13th South Asian Games** were held in **2019** in **Kathmandu and Pokhara, Nepal**. In this edition, **India** won a record-breaking **312 medals**, consisting of **174 Gold, 93 Silver, and 45 Bronze**.

• The official motto of the **South Asian Sports Council** is **Peace, Prosperity, and Progress**, reflecting the goal of regional integration through sports.

• **Afghanistan** is the newest member of the council, having joined in **2004** and making its debut in the **2006 South Asian Games** held in **Colombo, Sri Lanka**.

• The games are often referred to as the **South Asian Olympics** because they follow a similar format and provide a platform for regional athletes to prepare for larger international stages like the **Asian Games** and the **Olympic Games**.
